# The Overstory

By Powers.

It changed how I run the weekly review. The audiobook narrator is excellent. Favourite idea: write things down before you trust your memory.

Hugo recommended it after our conversation about focus. The writing is clear and the examples are memorable. Worth rereading in a year, especially the chapter on planning.

A good book for a long flight. The author uses many case studies, some feel cherry-picked. The ending surprised me, I did not see it coming.
